stories.headline: US Senate rejects limits on Trump's Iran war powers
body: The Senate voted 51–48 against a measure to make Trump end the Iran war or get Congress's approval.
Three Republicans voted for it.
The House passed it 220–204 in September.
stories.vc: Continued conflict keeps oil and shipping risk high.

stories.headline: Putin pitches Arctic shipping route to Asian investors
body: Putin used his APEC speech to seek investment in Russia's Arctic and the Northern Sea Route.
Russia wants year-round shipping; today it runs mainly in summer.
Analysts doubt it will become a major global lane.
stories.vc: A working Arctic route would cut Asia–Europe shipping times.

stories.headline: Iraq strikes a deal with Kataib Hezbollah over its stronghold
body: Iraq will set up a joint operations centre in Jurf al-Sakhar, a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold.
The compromise follows claims that the group was smuggling oil.
Forces will include brigades from the Popular Mobilisation Forces.
stories.vc: Cutting oil smuggling would help Iraq's budget.

stories.headline: Malaysia ends visa-free entry for Indians from January
body: Malaysia will end its 30-day visa exemption for Indians from January 1, 2027.
Travellers will need a visa before arriving.
The exemption began in December 2023.
stories.vc: Visa rules could dent India–Malaysia tourism.

stories.statLabel: proposed UPI fee on bigger merchant payments
stories.headline: UPI merchant fee may be delayed past 2027 state polls
body: A proposed fee on some UPI merchant payments may be pushed beyond the 2027 state elections, a report says.
The plan: 0.4% on eligible payments above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300.
The government fears merchant backlash.
stories.vc: Banks and payment apps lose a hoped-for revenue stream.

stories.headline: Paytm to invest up to ₹200 crore in Singapore's Funding Societies units
body: Paytm Singapore will invest up to ₹200 crore, including ₹162 crore for 19.1% of payments firm CardUp.
Paytm will supply payments and lending tech for fees and revenue share.
It's part of Paytm's overseas push.
stories.vc: Overseas tech licensing could diversify Paytm's revenue.

stories.statLabel: jobs Gadkari says platforms could create
stories.headline: Gadkari urges states to adopt rules for app taxis and bike taxis
body: Nitin Gadkari asked states to adopt the 2025 aggregator guidelines amid bike-taxi crackdowns.
He says app-based platforms could create up to 18 crore jobs.
The rules cover licensing, driver pay, insurance and safety.
stories.vc: Clear rules would help Rapido, Uber and Ola plan growth.

stories.headline: GTA VI launches after $1.5 billion in pre-sales
body: Grand Theft Auto VI launched after more than $1.5 billion in pre-sales.
Fans waited over 13 years for a new main game.
It comes after years of layoffs in the games industry.
stories.joke: Thirteen years of loading screen, finally over.
stories.vc: A mega-hit lifts Take-Two and the wider games sector.

stories.headline: UK forced to admit its secret order for Apple encryption backdoor
body: A UK tribunal ordered the government to confirm it secretly demanded Apple's encrypted customer data.
It rejected the Home Office's national security argument.
It's a rare rebuke for UK surveillance.
stories.joke: The secret's out about the secret.
stories.vc: Encryption fights affect how tech firms operate in the UK.

stories.headline: Uber tests rides for kids as young as 10
body: Uber is piloting 'Uber Kids' for children aged 10 and up in Austin, Nashville and Madison.
It builds on its teen service for ages 13–17.
Drivers get extra pay for these rides.
stories.vc: New customer groups help Uber keep growing.

stories.headline: Southern Black women and Latinas drove the midterm blue wave
body: The 19th says Black women and Latinas in the South powered Democrats' midterm wins.
Women won as candidates, organisers and voters.
Affordability and rights were key issues.
stories.vc: Women voters' priorities will shape spending debates.
